item.title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes Admission Controllers: Kyverno vs OPA Gatekeeper vs Kubewarden (2026)
item.description: Kubernetes admission controllers are the gatekeepers of your cluster — they intercept API requests before objects are persisted, allowing you to enforce security policies, validate configurations, and mutate resources automatically. In this guide, we compare three leading open-source admission controller frameworks: Kyverno, OPA Gatekeeper, and Kubewarden.

item.title: Best Self-Hosted Policy as Code Tools 2026: OPA vs Conftest vs Gatekeeper
item.description: Policy as Code is the practice of defining, testing, and enforcing organizational policies using machine-readable configuration files rather than manual processes. Instead of relying on human reviewers to check compliance, Policy as Code engines automatically evaluate configurations, infrastructure, and application behavior against defined rules.
